title: ChatGPT used by over 40 million worldwide for health questions
key_facts: OpenAI reported more than 40 million people use ChatGPT daily for health questions (Healthcare Dive headline, early Jan 2026)
More than 5% of all ChatGPT messages worldwide are about healthcare, billions each week
1.5 to 2 million weekly questions are about health insurance
OpenAI survey in December: 3 in 5 US adults used AI for health in the past three months; 55% to check symptoms
Over 580,000 healthcare messages a week from 'hospital deserts'
quote_evidence: More than 5% of all ChatGPT messages across the globe are about healthcare, averaging billions of messages each week, according to OpenAI.
AI chatbots can sometimes hallucinate, or give incorrect or misleading answers
why_it_matters_hint: Shows how widely people use chatbots for health, with accuracy risks.
event_date: OpenAI report, early Jan 2026 (Axios exclusive 5 Jan 2026; Healthcare Dive 6 Jan 2026)
